hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Calculate total points for each winery within each country by grouping on country and winery.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Rank wineries within each country using row number ordered by total points descending, winery name ascending.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Pivot the top 3 ranks into columns top_winery, second_winery, and third_winery using conditional aggregation with concat and fallback labels.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH WineryToTotalPoints AS (
    SELECT 
        country, 
        winery, 
        SUM(points) AS total_points 
    FROM Wineries 
    GROUP BY country, winery
), 
RankedWineries AS (
    SELECT 
        country,
        winery,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_points DESC, winery ASC) AS rn 
    FROM WineryToTotalPoints
) 
SELECT 
    country, 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CONCAT(winery, ' (', total_points, ')') END) AS top_winery, 
    IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CONCAT(winery, ' (', total_points, ')') END), 'No second winery') AS second_winery, 
    IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CONCAT(winery, ' (', total_points, ')') END), 'No third winery') AS third_winery 
FROM RankedWineries 
WHERE rn <= 3 
GROUP BY country 
ORDER BY country ASC;
```

WITH WineryToTotalPoints AS (
    SELECT 
        country, 
        winery, 
        SUM(points) AS total_points 
    FROM Wineries 
    GROUP BY country, winery
), 
RankedWineries AS (
    SELECT 
        country,
        winery,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_points DESC, winery ASC) AS rn 
    FROM WineryToTotalPoints
) 
SELECT 
    country, 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN winery || ' (' || total_points || ')' END) AS top_winery, 
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN winery || ' (' || total_points || ')' END), 'No second winery') AS second_winery, 
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN winery || ' (' || total_points || ')' END), 'No third winery') AS third_winery 
FROM RankedWineries 
WHERE rn <= 3 
GROUP BY country 
ORDER BY country ASC;

solutions.approach: Pandas Sort, Cumcount, and Pivot Formatting
solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def top_three_wineries(wineries: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    grouped = wineries.groupby(['country', 'winery'])['points'].sum().reset_index()
    grouped = grouped.sort_values(by=['country', 'points', 'winery'], ascending=[True, False, True])
    grouped['rn'] = grouped.groupby('country').cumcount() + 1
    
    countries = sorted(wineries['country'].unique())
    rows = []
    for c in countries:
        c_df = grouped[grouped['country'] == c]
        w1 = c_df[c_df['rn'] == 1]
        w2 = c_df[c_df['rn'] == 2]
        w3 = c_df[c_df['rn'] == 3]
        top_w = f"{w1.iloc[0]['winery']} ({w1.iloc[0]['points']})" if not w1.empty else None
        sec_w = f"{w2.iloc[0]['winery']} ({w2.iloc[0]['points']})" if not w2.empty else 'No second winery'
        thd_w = f"{w3.iloc[0]['winery']} ({w3.iloc[0]['points']})" if not w3.empty else 'No third winery'
        rows.append({'country': c, 'top_winery': top_w, 'second_winery': sec_w, 'third_winery': thd_w})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
